augmentation.titanbreak.tactical_eye.eff: Converts a targeted lifeform’s range, health, and threat signals into combat information.
augmentation.titanbreak.thermal_eye.effe: Tracks nearby biological heat signatures even through obscured sightlines.
augmentation.titanbreak.structural_secti: Separates armor layers from destructible structural boundaries in the analysis display.
augmentation.titanbreak.motion_predictio: Projects a short future position from observed movement.
augmentation.titanbreak.weakpoint_analys: Analyzes part damage and exposed weaknesses to support focused attacks.
augmentation.titanbreak.ballistic_eye.ef: Calculates lead positions and ballistic error against moving targets.
augmentation.titanbreak.multispectrum_ey: Recovers visual information in darkness and low-contrast conditions.
augmentation.titanbreak.electromagnetic_: Detects electromagnetic activity from machinery and high-output organs.
augmentation.titanbreak.target_assist.ef: Provides fine tracking correction when the crosshair passes close to a target.
augmentation.titanbreak.predictive_comba: Combines movement and attack cues to assist prediction of an enemy’s next action.
augmentation.titanbreak.reflex_accelerat: Reduces neural transmission delay to improve movement and close-combat response.
augmentation.titanbreak.threat_detection: Immediately warns of the approach direction of nearby hostile lifeforms.
Stabilizes body control and input synchronization during high-speed movement.
augmentation.titanbreak.combat_autopilot: Assists camera and movement direction toward the target during brief high-speed engagements.
Suppresses neural shock and control instability while severely injured.
augmentation.titanbreak.reflex_drive_i.e: Deploys a temporal field around the user and reorganizes combat around the user’s accelerated reaction timescale.
augmentation.titanbreak.powered_spine.ef: Amplifies spinal drive to improve strength, mobility, and impact resistance together.
augmentation.titanbreak.phase_step_spine: Briefly distorts collision boundaries during sudden movement to enable abrupt repositioning.
augmentation.titanbreak.gyro_stabilized_: Rapidly restores posture in midair and during high-speed rotation.
augmentation.titanbreak.kinetic_relay_sp: Recovers energy from impacts and acceleration and transfers it into the next action.
augmentation.titanbreak.high_speed_neura: Expands the neural bandwidth shared by multiple automated-control augmentations.
augmentation.titanbreak.artificial_heart: Stabilizes circulatory output to strengthen baseline survivability and recovery.
augmentation.titanbreak.dual_heart.effec: Runs an auxiliary heart in parallel to increase circulatory reserve under heavy load.
Provides a brief burst of output and reaction speed at critical moments.
Reduces blood-loss effects and recovery delay after major damage.
augmentation.titanbreak.overdrive_circul: Overdrives the circulatory system for higher combat output at the cost of sharply increased heat load.
augmentation.titanbreak.bioalloy_skeleto: Reinforces the skeleton with bioalloy to improve health, defense, and strength.
augmentation.titanbreak.impact_dispersal: Distributes localized impacts through the whole frame to withstand heavy blows.
Forms an armored layer beneath the skin to reduce physical damage.
Hardens the outer tissue at the moment of impact to resist repeated strikes.
augmentation.titanbreak.optical_camo_ski: Alters the optical properties of the exterior surface to make detection more difficult.
Spreads heat across the body surface to delay thermal saturation from high-output augmentations.
augmentation.titanbreak.blade_arm.effect: Replaces the arm with a cutting weapon for powerful close-range slashes.
augmentation.titanbreak.high_frequency_b: Uses a high-frequency vibrating edge to cut armor and hard surfaces rapidly.
augmentation.titanbreak.power_arm.effect: Uses high-output actuators to increase knockback, part-breaking, and structure-breaking power.
augmentation.titanbreak.wire_hook_arm.ef: Fires a wire to an anchor point for pulling and high-speed traversal.
augmentation.titanbreak.rail_projector_a: Launches high-velocity penetrating projectiles from an accelerator built into the arm.
augmentation.titanbreak.photon_emitter_a: Consumes massive power and heat capacity to emit a high-output penetrating beam.
augmentation.titanbreak.shock_palm.effec: Releases a high-voltage impact on contact to interrupt the target’s actions.
augmentation.titanbreak.shield_projector: Forms an energy barrier in front of the user for a short time.
augmentation.titanbreak.precision_tool_a: Provides multipurpose tool functions for non-combat work and fine manipulation.
Increases lower-body drive for faster and more sustained movement.
augmentation.titanbreak.jump_booster_leg: Uses impulse thrust to increase jump height and aerial entry speed.
Generates powerful thrust on the ground and in the air for explosive mobility.
augmentation.titanbreak.wall_run_spurs.e: Secures traction on walls to enable short wall-runs and direction changes.
augmentation.titanbreak.impact_absorber_: Absorbs landing and fall impacts so combat can resume immediately after high-speed descents.
augmentation.titanbreak.nano_repair_orga: Gradually repairs minor damage while the body is in a stable state.
augmentation.titanbreak.auxiliary_power_: Expands the power reserve available to active augmentations.
